purpose: Phase E candidate-coverage check for candidate-level DOP from the raw DFSAR L0A-RAW product
footprint_source: isda:Geometry_Parameters block in the raw .dat XML label (upper_left/upper_right/lower_left/lower_right/centre lat/lon)
distance_method: Haversine great-circle distance on a sphere of radius 1,737,400 m (isda:semi_major_radius = isda:semi_minor_radius, eccentricity 0 per the same XML)

independent_corroboration.method: Sub-satellite point computed from the geometry CSV's first ephemeris row (Lunar Fixed Frame x,y,z -> spherical lat/lon), using the same sphere radius.
independent_corroboration.conclusion: Ephemeris-derived ground track longitude (~-6 deg at acquisition start, sweeping toward the XML corner longitudes -23 to -77 deg) is self-consistent with the XML footprint corners and independently confirms the acquisition track is nowhere near candidate longitude +79.764 deg.

verdict_detail: The candidate is ~266-280 km from every footprint corner and from the scene center. The scene itself is a narrow strip only ~135 km long (along-track) by ~2.6 km wide (cross-track/swath, consistent with the XML isda:swath=4850 m and the instrument description's L-band footprint of ~22.5-34 km). The candidate is roughly 2x the scene's own along-track length away from the nearest edge, and >100x the scene's cross-track width away. This is not a marginal/boundary case attributable to geolocation uncertainty (the product's own stated geolocation precision is not close to hundreds of km) -- it is a clear, unambiguous non-overlap.
conclusion_for_dop_pipeline: Phases F-J (candidate window extraction, calibration for the candidate window, candidate-level DOP calculation, DOP validation, comparison with Pv/CPR/SERD/T-Ratio/PSR for the candidate) CANNOT proceed for this raw product / candidate pair. This is the sole raw DFSAR product present under PRISM/data (per task instructions, no other copy was searched for or downloaded). No candidate-level DOP can be scientifically computed from the currently available raw DFSAR data.
